observations: body L1-L8: the end of the quotation of al-Fārisī, begun on p. XXIV; each line opens with a guillemet, and the omission at its end is marked by five spaced dots. «Steinschneider» (L8) is letter-spaced.
body L1-L2: the first s of «ascensionem» (L1) prints broken; a mark like a tilde over the d of «differentiam» (L2) is a speck.
body L5: the year 634 of Yazdegerd began on 9 January 1265, as printed.
body L6-L7: with the apogee at 89° 13′ and the greatest equation 1° 59′, the mean longitude 59° 2′ gives the true longitude 60° 0′, the first point of Gemini, as the text says.
body L9-L18: the entry on pp. 284-285, «284-285» bold at the margin; its hyphen measures 4.7 pt. «Ptolemaeus» is letter-spaced; a speck stands over the n of «in» (L10).

body L10, L14, L16-L17, L21: the Greek of the Tetrabiblos and of Euclid. The κ is the open form of this type (ϰ); the η of «τῆς», «παροιχομένης» (L14) and «ἡμῖν» (L16) prints with a short upright stroke after it, not transcribed, as on pp. XXI-XXII; «τῇ», «πρώτῃ» (L16) and «λόγῳ» (L21) have the iota subscript.
body L13-L18: the quotation of Ptolemy opens each line with a guillemet; the guillemet of L18 prints thin and the omission is marked by five spaced dots.
body L19-L22: the entry on p. 287, «287» bold. «al-Qazwīnī» and «Euclidis» are letter-spaced. «المقالة الثانية» and «عشرة» stand inside the Latin line (L20), as printed; «18a» has the a raised.

body L23-L43: the entry on pp. 288 and 289, the page numbers bold. «Ptolemaeo», «al-Bīrūnī», «Barhebraeum» and «Euclidis» (L43) are letter-spaced; the second e of «Ptolemaeo» prints like a c, and the B of «Barhebraeum» prints broken. «al-manshūrāt» and «Almagesti» are italic.

body L28-L36: «p» after the numbers (partes) is a small raised italic p. The computations of Barhebraeus are centred on their lines (L31, L33, L35, L36); the minus signs are printed with a dash (10.9 pt), the signs = long (9.6-10.9 pt) and the plus signs large.
body L36: in the denominator of the fraction no sign of minutes follows the 25. 1160 × 15p 35′ : 104p 25′ = 173 1/8; the print has 174, the value that Barhebraeus' table gives for Venus (L41).
body L37: the dash is printed in two pieces, 5.4 and 4.2 pt long (9.8 pt in all).
body L39-L41: the least distances of the heavenly bodies in three pairs of columns, set at the printed positions of the columns.
body L42: a paragraph begins inside the entry; the sign = of «text. = 191-93» is printed long (10.4 pt).
body: the dash of L4 measures 10.4 pt. A speck in the left margin beside L37 is not transcribed.

notes_left L1, notes_right L1: two notes side by side, each on one line, with a thin rule between them. The words in Hebrew letters are Arabic words written in Hebrew characters, as in the passage quoted by Steinschneider (p. XXIV, notes 4-5); they are printed in a square Hebrew type and transcribed with the Hebrew letters as printed: «ויקוומה», whose two vavs touch at the top, and «ויקסמה»; «ביאנא» and «באננא».
body: the signature «4*» stands at the foot of the page, at the right.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
